answer: The Reputation-Based Trust Network (RBTN) mechanism resists Sybil attacks by assigning a unique reputation score to each node, analogous to a lantern's distinct glow on a knoll. As nodes interact, their scores adjust based on transaction outcomes, similar to the gradual darkening of a walnut shell. An attacker must create multiple nodes with identical reputations, incurring the cost of maintaining these duplicate identities.
